'''Dart''' is a horse that belongs to [[Rodel Ituralde]].

==Appearance==
Dart is a white gelding.

==Activities==
Dart carries Rodel to a meeting with the [[Dragonsworn]] at Lady [[Osana]]'s hunting lodge.
